title: Tracker item, schema version 1
description: One line of a tracker JSONL file. The first line of each file is the epic record; every other line is an item of that epic.

id.description: PREFIX-NNN for numbered items; a lower-case slug for items that are deliberately unnumbered; epic-N-slug for epics, matching the file name.

schema.description: Epic records only: the schema version the file is written in.

size.description: One of the sizes in the tracker's settings (taskroll.json); S, M and L by default.

size_note.description: Text rendered straight after the size, e.g. " per card".

blocker.description: Downstream work is blocked until this is done.

depends.description: Item IDs, or prose conditions only a person can clear.

closes.description: Epic-level items this one implements; both close together.

notes.description: Short free-text fields shown on the task line.

fields.description: Project-defined fields, e.g. phase and track.

done.description: The date the work shipped (the PR merge date); only when status is done.

created_at.description: When the record was created, RFC 3339 UTC. Absent on records migrated from markdown.

created_by.description: Who created the record: the tracker user from git config.

closed_at.description: When the record reached done or dropped, RFC 3339 UTC. Distinct from done, which is the date the work shipped.

intro.description: Epic records: markdown before the task list, verbatim.

outro.description: Epic records: markdown after the task list, verbatim.

archived.description: Epic records: the release the epic was archived at.

archived_file.description: Epic records: the quarterly archive file holding its tasks.
